sources_used: web search: UK rhythm game / DDR / Pump It Up / StepManiaX locations

findings.name: Richardson's Family Entertainment Centre
findings.evidence_quote: Picture titled 'StepmaniaX - Richardson Yacht club - Hemsby, Norfolk' on ZIv page. Games table as of 2025-07-03 only lists Twisted: Nitro Stunt Racing.
findings.note: StepManiaX photo on ZIv is positive historical/possibly current evidence, but SMX is not in the current games list. Hemsby Yacht Club Leisure Complex FEC; do not treat as certain without a re-visit.

findings.name: Richardson's Family Entertainment Centre
findings.evidence_quote: Has undergone renovation. All the machines have been replaced with common modern shit/shitty raw thrills. Listed: Dinosaur King, Injustice Arcade, Cruis'n Blast, Mario Kart Arcade GP DX, Jurassic Park Arcade, Terminator Salvation.
findings.note: Lowestoft Richardson's FEC post-refurb list is racing/shooter/redemption style only; no music games. Source is 2020; re-check would help.

findings.name: Riverside Bowl
findings.evidence_quote: Bowling alley in New Brighton with an arcade. Games: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX; Jurassic Park Arcade Deluxe Motion; Crossy Road Arcade; Flying Tickets; Sonic Sports Basketball; Space Invaders Frenzy. No music-game category entries.
findings.note: Fresh 2025 catalog visit; only racing/redemption/sports cabs. No bemani or other rhythm titles.

findings.name: Robin Hood caravan park
findings.evidence_quote: Supernova gone 31/07/18. Lots of new redemption games in place. Very large arcade with all sorts of arcade games and ticket games. Games table empty.
findings.note: DDR SuperNOVA removed 2018; no current machine inventory. Seasonal caravan-park arcade. Not enough positive evidence for confirmed_none.

findings.name: Roller Bowl
findings.evidence_quote: Current games: Animal Kaiser PLUS, Injustice Arcade, Mario Kart Arcade GP DX, The Walking Dead, Basketball Pro, NERF Arcade, Spinner Frenzy. Comment (14 years ago): Used to have a Japanese SuperNOVA, got rid of it for DDR X. Neither SuperNOVA nor DDR X on current list.
findings.note: Romford City Pavilion. Historical DDR lineage gone; 2024 list is non-music only.

findings.name: Rollerbowl
findings.evidence_quote: As of 15/02/2025: neat little indie bowling alley... selection is so sparse... few rail shooters and driving cabinets. Games: Sega Rally 3, Sonic & Sega All-Stars Racing, Super Bikes 2, Dark Escape 4D, Terminator Salvation. Comment: went for the ds fusion cab and it wasn't there. asked a staff member who told me that it's been gone for a long time.
findings.note: Inverness Rollerbowl. Staff confirmed Dancing Stage Fusion long gone; 2025 visit listed only racing/shooters.

findings.name: Roxy Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: All the arcade machines are gone now, all they have left are 2 basketball machines. Games: Basketball Machine x2.
findings.note: Roxy Ball Room Merrion Street Leeds. Venue still open as ball-games bar (roxyleisure.co.uk); video-game arcade section cleared. No rhythm games.

findings.name: Ryde Superbowl
findings.evidence_quote: A few games here, but all you see is redemption. Listed: Mario Kart GP DX, Jurassic Park Arcade, Walking Dead, claws, Crossy Road, Spinner Frenzy, Spongebob pusher, Willy Crash, PAC-MAN Basket, Air FX.
findings.note: Isle of Wight superbowl arcade. Thorough non-music list; source is 2019 so confidence capped at likely.

findings.name: Salt Hill Activity Centre
findings.evidence_quote: Not many arcade games here. Games: Dead Heat (2P), Super Bikes 2, Terminator Salvation (Unknown Model). All at the back of the arcade.
findings.note: Slough activity centre; only racing/shooter cabs documented. No music games found.

findings.name: Sands
findings.evidence_quote: Small arcade conjoined to pub. Small family arcade with a few 2p pushers. Had a decent'ish Extreme, but wasn't there on visit today.
findings.note: Towyn Sands. Visitor explicitly notes DDR Extreme gone as of July 2024; games table empty (redemption only).

findings.name: Sands Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Sands Amusements, Beach Road Hemsby. Games: No games at this location. Website sandshemsby.com.
findings.note: Seaside amusement arcade with no ZIv machine inventory. No independent rhythm-game evidence; not enough for confirmed_none.

findings.name: Sandside Penny Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Sandside Penny Arcade, Scarborough YO11 1PE. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Name implies classic penny arcade; no catalog of machines online. Unknown for rhythm games.

findings.name: Searles Leisure Resort
findings.evidence_quote: Not the best arcade in my opinion. Only listed game: Pool Table.
findings.note: Hunstanton holiday resort arcade poorly documented; only pool logged. Weak positive evidence of no rhythm; confidence low.

findings.name: Sega Arcade @ Wendy's
findings.evidence_quote: Arcade attached to Wendy's in separate room. Has other games such as air hockey, basket ball hoops and has a soft play area. Games: Men In Black, Claw Machine, Pixel Chase, Mario & Sonic Olympic Games Tokyo 2020 Arcade Edition.
findings.note: Hull Kingswood small Sega FEC room; no rhythm cabs on 2024 list.

findings.name: Serendipity Games Centre
findings.evidence_quote: Only listed game: Deal or No Deal (redemption), right next to the entrance.
findings.note: Tenby games centre; documented as redemption. No music games found.

findings.name: Shanklin Summer Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: This is mainly redemption, but... Games: Minecraft Dungeons Arcade, Deal Or No Deal Pusher, Lane Master, NERF Arcade, Scooby Doo Redemption Wheel, Snakes & Ladders Pusher, Space Invaders Frenzy, Pac-Man Smash Slimline.
findings.note: Isle of Wight Shanklin; full list is redemption/novelty only, no rhythm.

findings.name: Shipleys Riverside Bowl
findings.evidence_quote: Arcade in treasure island. DDR cabinet is hidden at the back with the rail shooters. StepMania Converted Cabinet: Euromix 2 cab with oversized flat screen. Runs Beware's Extreme theme for SM 3.9, playing only the songs that came out on Extreme, plus some random files.
findings.note: Stourport Treasure Island / Shipley's. Homebrew StepMania on Euromix cab (not commercial StepManiaX), so slug other. Last ZIv update 2020; venue area still open as fair/arcade but SM cab status unverified.

findings.name: Shore Leisure
findings.evidence_quote: Rustic seaside amusement, good playing Euromix2 though! Update 05/11/2022: As far as I know the Euromix 2 isn't there anymore, however it may have just being repaired or in storage. 2023 games list is long redemption/ticket set only (Pac-Man Pixel Bash, Mario Kart GP 2, etc.).
findings.note: Seaburn/Sunderland coast. Euromix 2 reported missing Nov 2022; subsequent full list has no music games. Treat as no current rhythm unless re-found.

findings.name: Silcock's Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: A basic arcade which consists of mostly redemption machines and not much else. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Southport Nevill St Silcock's leisure-casino style site; 2025 note says redemption/AGC style, no music cabs listed.

findings.name: Silcock's Fun Palace
findings.evidence_quote: Silcock's Fun Palace, 125-141 Promenade Blackpool. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Blackpool Promenade amusement palace; ZIv stub only. No inventory, no external rhythm hits. Unknown.

findings.name: Silcock's Funland & Pier
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International). Location: On the right hand side a little way into the arcade. Comment: Not great condition - Most buttons are really hard to press... £1 - 1 Play. Also GRID, Super Bikes 2, Fast and Furious, Star Wars Battle Pod, redemptions.
findings.note: Southport Funland. Guitar Hero Arcade is a music game outside the named bemani/slugs list, mapped to other. Recent 2026 ZIv update. Official site is family ticket/AGC focus; GH is the only music title logged.

findings.name: Silcock's Funtime
findings.evidence_quote: Appeared to be a mixture of Bandits and possibly redemption (Didnt enter), also possibly has pool/bowling in the back. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Southport Nevill St. Observer describes bandits/redemption; no music games. Partial exterior-only visit.

findings.name: Silcock's Golden Sovereign
findings.evidence_quote: A very basic arcade with mostly 2p machines and some bandits. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Southport; 2p pushers and bandits. No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Silver Dollar
findings.evidence_quote: Only listed game: The Addams Family pinball (back left before the over 18s area).
findings.note: Scarborough Foreshore. Recent 2026 update; pinball/over-18s area focus, no music games.

findings.name: Silver Slipper
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International). £1.00 for 1 song. Condition Great. Page last updated 2009-07-18.
findings.note: Great Yarmouth Marine Parade. Only ZIv music entry is Guitar Hero from 2009; treat as unverified presence. No newer catalog found.

findings.name: Slots of Fun
findings.evidence_quote: Blackpool Promenade. Listed: Balloon Buster, Boxer, Claw Machine, Doodle Jump Arcade, Ice Age Great Ice Breaker, Key Master, Lighthouse, Slam-A-Winner, Sonic Sports Basketball, Stacker. Plus more redemption (Shark Park, Sooty Show, etc.).
findings.note: Ticket/redemption seaside arcade; no rhythm titles on visit log.

findings.name: Smiles for Miles 1
findings.evidence_quote: Strange collection of amusements split into three buildings really close together, but not part of the same arcade. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Withernsea multi-unit amusements; no machine list. Unknown for rhythm.

findings.name: Smiles for Miles 2
findings.evidence_quote: Sibling unit of Smiles for Miles Withernsea cluster (same address range 5-7 Memorial Avenue). Shard notes empty; same multi-building stub pattern as unit 1 on ZIv.
findings.note: No per-unit game inventory found. Do not attach unit-1 notes as games list. Unknown.

findings.name: Smiles for Miles 3
findings.evidence_quote: Third unit of Withernsea Smiles for Miles multi-building amusements; no independent machine catalog found.
findings.note: Same cluster as z9149/z9147. Unknown.

findings.name: South Parade Pier
findings.evidence_quote: As far as actual arcade games though, it's mostly ticket games around here. Listed: Cruis'n Blast, Mario Kart Arcade GP 2, Transformers Human Alliance, Ben Bones, Grand Piano Keys, Ice Man, Ring Toss, Sink It, Skeeball, Slam-A-Winner.
findings.note: Southsea pier arcade is ticket/redemption + a few video cabs; no music games. Source 2019.

findings.name: South Pier
findings.evidence_quote: Games: GRID (Twin Cab 2P), The Fast and the Furious (2P). Pictures of Wangan Midnight Maximum Tune. No music games listed.
findings.note: Lowestoft South Pier. Racing-focused; no rhythm on 2024 update.

findings.name: Southwold Pier
findings.evidence_quote: Over the past few years this pier's arcade section has had a few renovations with a completely new look, thus getting rid of a few old arcade machines, including Dancing Stage Euromix. Only remaining listed video game: Time Crisis 4.
findings.note: Explicit removal of Dancing Stage Euromix after renovations. Known for Tim Hunkin Under the Pier Show automata rather than music games.

findings.name: St Annes Pier
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International). Comment: Didn't play but looked fine. In front of Lost World. £1.00. Also location comments reference 'Behind Pump' and 'Near Euromix'; page has pictures titled Pump Pro and Euromix, but those titles are not currently in the games table.
findings.note: Lytham St Annes Pier. Guitar Hero Arcade listed 2024 as Music Game -> other. Pump Pro / Euromix appear only as photos and landmark text, not current games rows; do not mark pump_it_up or ddr without a re-confirm.

findings.name: St Osyth Beach Holiday Park
findings.evidence_quote: Manned by Park Holidays UK. Games: Animal Kaiser, Batman, Jurassic Park Arcade, Candy Crush Saga, Ice Man, Spongebob pusher, PAC-MAN Basket.
findings.note: Holiday-park FEC; listed cabs are non-music. Older 2019 inventory.

findings.name: Stardust Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Mostly redemption. Only video listed: The Fast and the Furious: Drift (2P) both dead.
findings.note: Hopton seaside amusements; redemption focus, no music games.

findings.name: Strikes Bowl and LaserQuest
findings.evidence_quote: Typical bowling alley, machine gets moderate use. Games table empty. Comment ~15 years ago: EM2 pads are OK, but very slippy at times.
findings.note: Sudbury. Historical Euromix 2 pads comment is very old; no current inventory. Cannot confirm presence or absence of rhythm now.

findings.name: Sunderland Bowl
findings.evidence_quote: At one point this place had a Euromix 2, but it was removed after a remodel. Plenty of variety including rail shooters. Current games: Mario Kart GP DX, Mission Impossible Arcade, Transformers Human Alliance, Bop It, claws, Key Master, Plants vs Zombies, Sonic Sports Basketball, Treasure Quest.
findings.note: Explicit post-remodel removal of Euromix 2; 2025 non-music list matches.

findings.name: Sunspot Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: General redemption games and such. Games: No games at this location. TripAdvisor: Lots of games and really clean amusements... Games such as nerf gun, 2p...
findings.note: Woolacombe Barton Rd. Redemption/2p/Nerf type seaside arcade; no rhythm mentions in ZIv or visitor blurbs.

findings.name: Sunspot Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Despite this location not having any BEMANI titles at present, this arcade has one of the very few synced Guitar Hero cabinets. Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade, right side of the arcade, £0.50 for 1 song, Perfect.
findings.note: Burnham-on-Sea Sunspot (different from Woolacombe). Guitar Hero Arcade -> other. Last ZIv update 2021; not re-confirmed since.
